run_sam3_lite_text_segmentation: run SAM3 Lite Text model to segment an image given a text prompt and optional bounding box inputs
create_text_embeddings: create pre-computed text embeddings from input_ids for reuse across multiple image inference calls
create_vision_embeddings: create pre-computed vision embeddings from pixel_values for reuse across multiple text prompt inference calls
encode_geometry_prompts: encode geometric bounding box prompts with ROI-aligned vision features for spatial conditioning
build_image_segmentation_output: build image segmentation output with predicted masks, boxes, logits, and semantic segmentation from model forward pass
